annotations.title: Read a UFC card's estimate and sales

description: Read the saved estimate and recent recorded sales for one exact UFC card version identified by its catalogue cardId. Prices are USD. The estimate pools raw and graded sales and is not a physical-copy or grader-specific appraisal. Returns dates, known sale sources, a history truncation flag and an Octagon link. Missing estimates remain missing.

cardId.description: The exact version's cardId returned by search_ufc_cards.

salesLimit.description: Maximum recent exact-card sales, newest first. This is not a complete market history.
